source.version: Part 13 — Terpenes, Volatiles, and Other Secondary Metabolites — Batch 04
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-256–260 were reconciled against the controlled Volume 13 manuscript plus direct cannabis drying/storage experiments, modified-atmosphere packaging data, validated 93-terpenoid analytical work, the 89,923-sample US commercial chemotaxonomy study, receptor-level terpene interaction experiments, and a 2024 randomized human D-limonene/THC trial. Public wording rejects universal drying or packaging recipes, treats sampling and analytical method as part of the result, separates commercial names from measured chemovars, and treats 'entourage' as a family of specific testable interaction claims rather than blanket proof.
source.note: This batch completes controlled Volume 13 through volatile loss, storage chemistry, terpene measurement, chemovar classification, and evidence-calibrated constituent-interaction claims.
